newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek drachma firms on continued forex inflows.
newsitem.headline: Greek drachma firms on continued forex inflows.

text.p: The drachma garnered more strength on the ecu and mark on the heels of speculative inflows of 260 million ecus at the central bank's fixing, dealers said.
"Depos are holding but forex forwards have plummeted 30 to 40 basis points up to one month with the drop less pronounced in longer tenors on continued forex inflows," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Traders said about 260 million ecus, $15 million and 15 million marks were sold at the fixing.
"The drachma has firmed versus the ecu and the mark in late dealings," said a trader at a foreign bank.
The central bank drained overnight money at an unchanged 12.40 percent. The surplus liquidity was put at over 100 billion drachmas.
Bond traders said activity in the secondary bond market was high today with buying interest focused on FRNs carrying spreads of 200 basis points.
"Banks and mutual funds went hunting for FRN paper today, especially those featuring spreads of 200 basis points," said a bond trader at a foreign bank.
Other trader said plenty of cash, lack of FRN auction at mid-month and expectations of lower yields lured players into buying treasuries.
The mark was quoted at 156.36/41 drachmas from Tuesday's 156.585 fix, the dollar at 240.56/61 drachmas from 239.730 and the Ecu at 300.12/22 from 300.300 drachmas.
